notes: Two Rivers Public Health Department (Kearney), a public health district reporting governmental funds only (manifest type 'hospital'; recorded as 'other'). GAAP basis. Receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (p4). The 'Miscellaneous' revenue line 95,974 is split using the program schedule on p6 (Expense reimbursements 63,843 + Other income 32,131). Loan principal payments (53,964) printed under Other financing sources (uses) are recorded as a debt service principal disbursement with outside_printed_total: true (reported_totals stay as printed); other_financing is null. Roll-forward: 2,259,789 + 3,539,202 - 3,096,493 - 53,964 = 2,648,534. Balance sheet: the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, report p10, added by the find_pages v8 re-trim) is used: total assets 6,296,210 + deferred outflows 213,524 = liabilities 2,344,186 + deferred inflows 274,168 + net position 3,891,380. Long term debt 2,128,587 is not split by due date, so it is recorded as debt - due in more than one year. The governmental funds balance sheet (p3: cash 2,207,607, receivables 575,301, liabilities 134,374, unassigned fund balance 2,648,534) is no longer used for balance_sheet. ending_cash = cash in bank and on hand per p3 (same figure on p1). Detail: the p6 Combining Statement by Program (General Fund) is the detailed schedule that ties to the GAAP statement (revenues 3,539,202; expenditures 3,096,493); the p5 cash-basis budget-and-actual schedule (different actuals: revenues 3,756,760, expenditures 3,099,176, with budget) was NOT recorded to avoid double counting. Indirect cost allocation lines net to zero across programs (Indirect Costs column is -509,658). Interfund transfers within the General Fund programs net to zero (12,076 + 8,288 - 28,379 + 8,015). Category/object mappings (e.g. Automobile expenses -> repairs and maintenance, Computer expenses -> professional/contract services, Capital outlay -> equipment purchases) are judgment calls. Detail column placement was verified by column totals tying to each program's printed total. Statement of Activities (p2) agrees: expenditures 3,160,307 on the government-wide basis; change in net position 359,235, beginning net position as restated 3,532,145. Report pp34-36 (between the fund statements and the schedules) are still not trimmed. Read pages 1-6 of 6
